title: Stratonovich Waves Driven by Space-Time Gaussian Noise: Second Moment and Exact Asymptotics. Manuscript and development history
description: The manuscript, its reading edition and the filtered Git history of a research project on the stochastic wave equation with multiplicative Gaussian noise, fractional in time, in the Stratonovich sense (the hyperbolic Anderson model) in dimensions one to three. The project identifies the large-time behaviour of the second moment at the scale t^kappa, kappa = (4 - alpha - alpha_0)/(3 - alpha), with a constant given by an explicit variational formula. The work was developed by Le Chen with his AI research system; the filtered history records the proof revisions, review runs, failed routes and decisions that could be published; REDACTIONS.md lists what was removed and why. The verification status of each result is in VERIFICATION.md.
